tool_args.rationale: Fit a saturating input response and a nonlinear bounded gradient sink numerically to all seven observations. Fresh confirmation will test whether this smooth extrapolation meets the requested tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Hydraulic basin with fixed linear gradient saturation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The low- and high-gradient measurements indicate stronger gradient dependence than the recalled nominal form; a fitted gradient exponent allows that dependence to be tested.
The pilot favors a saturating monotone input response, while the gradient probe supplies evidence for a bounded sink effect.
The available observations already cover the target horizon and include two off-pilot gradient values; try fresh confirmation before paying for a trajectory.
It is not informative for the target law.
